Defend the whole storm against seams at 1:6-7 and 1:10-11 and the larger 1:1-16 parent; hurling, fear, questions, calm, sacrifice, and vows decide no conversion, guilt, miracle, or theology.
Pressure 1:16|1:17, 1:17|2:1, 2:1|2:2, and 2:9|2:10; retain prayer/frame alternatives while selecting no versification, witness, source, death-state, miracle, sign, fulfillment, or theology.
Defend ending before immediate city response while 3:1-10 remains coherent; city measure and forty/three wording cannot decide witness, geography, chronology, historicity, or fulfillment.

Defend merging public response, decree, turning, and divine response; test 3:5-9 plus 3:10 and 3:1-10 without settling regime identity, animal practice, repentance, raah/shuv/nacham, causation, or divine mutability.
Defend 4:1-4 against attachment to 3:10 or 4:5-11; decide no psychology, moral status, quotation direction, divine attributes, death-wish ethics, relenting doctrine, or theology.
